svg.title: T2 FIFO backlog during the observation window
svg.desc: 3050 Mb/s offered load · 100 ms observation cutoff · 3 matched seeds · ABmin in bytes per SFU. The line shows the mean of the per-seed 5 ms means. Shading spans the seed min–max. Each frame-start sample sums the T2 FIFOs across SFUs. All panels use the same time and packet scales.

g.text: T2 FIFO backlog during the observation window
3050 Mb/s offered load · 100 ms observation cutoff · 3 matched seeds · ABmin in bytes per SFU
The line shows the mean of the per-seed 5 ms means. Shading spans the seed min–max.
Each frame-start sample sums the T2 FIFOs across SFUs. All panels use the same time and packet scales.
